snippet.title: Sifu Mobile | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
The same action, the same aura, the same atmosphere. Now in the palm of your hands.

Step into Sifu mobile and relive the experience on the go! Celebrate skill, perseverance, and personal improvement, where failure isn't the end.

Sifu is launching on iOS & Android on October 12th! 📱

App Store (iOS): https://apps.apple.com/app/sifu/id6762813110
Google Play (Android) : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.keplerinteractive.sifuthegame
